title: Pakistan Fish Inspection and Quality Control Amendment Ordinance 1998

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Fish Inspection and Quality Control Amendment Ordinance 1998
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XI OF 1998
PAKISTAN FISH
INSPECTION AND QUALITY CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE XI OF 1998
An Ordinance to
amend the Pakistan Fish Inspection and Quality Control Act, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 29th October, 1998]
No. F.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
29-10-1998.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Fish
Inspection and Quality Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Fish Inspection and Quality Control Amendment Ordinance 1998
sections.description:
Amendment of section 5, Act XXXV of 1997

ORDINANCE XI OF 1998
PAKISTAN FISH
INSPECTION AND QUALITY CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE XI OF 1998
An Ordinance to
amend the Pakistan Fish Inspection and Quality Control Act, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 29th October, 1998]
No. F.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
29-10-1998.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 5, Act
XXXV of 1997.---In the Pakistan Fish Inspection and Quality Control Act,
1997 (XXXV of 1997), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 5, in
subsection (1), the words "and a broad based trade association of fish
processing plants", at the end, shall be omitted.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Fish Inspection and Quality Control Amendment Ordinance 1998
sections.description:
Amendment of section 12, Act XXXV of 1997

ORDINANCE XI OF 1998
PAKISTAN FISH
INSPECTION AND QUALITY CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE XI OF 1998
An Ordinance to
amend the Pakistan Fish Inspection and Quality Control Act, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 29th October, 1998]
No. F.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
29-10-1998.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 12,
Act XXXV of 1997.--In the said Act, in section 12, in subsection (1), for
clauses (i) to (iv) the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(i) on a
first conviction with fine which may extend to one hundred thousand rupees;
(ii) on a second
conviction with fine which may extend to two hundred thousand rupees; and
(iii) for any subsequent conviction with imprisonment for a
term which may extend to one year, or with fine which may extend to five
hundred thousand rupees, or with both."
